name: oracle-migration
title: Oracle migration (Oracle Offering pack)
summary: Assess the Oracle estate, design the target, build the migration as verified features, validate data and rollback, then hand over.

stages.name: assess
stages.goal: Inventory the estate and write the assessment.
stages.exit: The user accepts the assessment and its recommendation.

stages.name: design
stages.goal: Design the target schema, sizing and migration approach.
stages.exit: The user accepts the technical design.

stages.name: build
stages.goal: Build the migration as verified features.

stages.name: validate
stages.goal: Prove data integrity and a rehearsed rollback; write the runbook.
stages.exit: The user accepts the validation evidence and the runbook.

stages.name: release
stages.goal: Reflect on the output and hand over.
stages.exit: Output reflection decides pass or human-review.
